props.name: actions
props.description: Action elements or controls displayed alongside the alert.

props.name: as
props.description: Element or component to render as.

props.name: children
props.description: Direct children content. Rendered within the alert content area.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: closable
props.description: Whether to show a dismiss button.

props.name: closeIcon
props.description: Custom icon name or element for the close button.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Uncontrolled default open state.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting detailed description.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Whether to display as an edge-to-edge banner with flat borders.

props.name: hasDescription
props.description:
Context variant indicating whether multi-line description is present.
Controls compact single-line vs multi-line layout and icon scale.

props.name: icon
props.description:
Leading icon displayed in the alert.
- `undefined` (default): automatically resolves to semantic icon for status types, or none for `primary` / `secondary`.
- `false` or `null`: hides the icon.
- `IconT.Name`: displays specified icon shortcut (e.g. `'icon-tip'`) or custom JSX element.

props.name: onExitComplete
props.description: Callback fired when exit animation has fully settled and element is unmounted.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback when open state changes.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: title
props.description: Primary alert title or message.

props.name: translations
props.description: Localized message overrides for this alert instance.

props.name: type
props.description: Semantic intent of the alert.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual surface variant.
